extraction.Name: Charles Cuny, Senior
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment at the time he received it, but that he was told by the Indian Agency that it was necessary for him to take it, so he accepted this patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged it to the Federal Loan Bank, of Omaha, Nebraska, for $1200.00
extraction.Buyer: Federal Loan Bank of Omaha, Nebraska for $1200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes on his allotment, and, in 1924, he mortgaged it to the Federal Loan Bank, of Omaha, Nebraska, for $1200.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: his only income is by farming
extraction.NOTES: Patent covers W2 of Sec. 8, T. 41N, Ro 45W; mentally competent; health is fair, being bothered principally with kidney trouble; has a wife and seven minor children to support; health of the family is good; has kept up payments on mortgage; has kept up taxes since borrowing money except will be delinquent on 1928 taxes; has never received any help from the County or Government; document sworn November 16, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
